title: Add support for Flexy Pool wrapped datasources
body:
Psi Probe already supports several concrete connection pools, while Flexy Pool sits on top of those pools as a wrapper. This change teaches Probe to recognize Flexy Pool wrappers and reuse the existing pool-specific datasource support instead of treating Flexy Pool as a separate replacement pool.

- **What changed**
  - Added `FlexyPoolDatasourceAccessor` in `psi-probe-core`
  - Registered the accessor in `ProbeConfig` so wrapped datasources are inspected during normal resource resolution
  - Unwrapped `com.vladmihalcea.flexypool.FlexyPoolDataSource` via `getTargetDataSource()` and delegated to existing accessors for:
    - C3P0
    - DBCP2
    - HikariCP
    - Oracle / UCP
    - OpenEJB / TomEE
    - Tomcat JDBC pool
    - Vibur
    - Tomcat 10/11 DBCP, when present at runtime

- **Behavior**
  - Probe now reports datasource metadata for Flexy Pool-backed resources using the underlying pool implementation
  - Reset support follows the underlying accessor behavior, so resettable wrapped pools continue to work through the wrapper

- **Tests**
  - Added focused tests for:
    - wrapper detection
    - info delegation to an underlying supported pool
    - reset delegation to an underlying resettable pool
    - accessor registration in `ProbeConfig`

- **Example**
  ```java
  Object resource = new FlexyPoolDataSource<>(hikariDataSource);
  DataSourceInfo info = new FlexyPoolDatasourceAccessor().getInfo(resource);

  // info is resolved from the wrapped Hikari datasource
  ```
